name: tree

frames.best_why: Shows both folder levels, an expanded public folder and a selected file, with no cursor over the tree.

tagline: Folders open and files highlight inside a narrow project sidebar.
summary: A file tree in a small bordered card, with chevrons on folders and file icons on the leaves. Rows highlight on selection, and folders expand in place to reveal their contents.
appearance: A compact card on black holds a vertical list of folders and files, each a single line with a small grey icon, one-step indentation per level and a chevron on folders. The selected row is a grey rounded bar and expanded folders push their children below them.
behaviour: Clicking a row selects it with a grey fill; clicking a folder's chevron flips the arrow and opens or closes its children, shifting the rows underneath. The clip opens public, moves the selection between files and collapses components again.
demo_content: A small project tree with src, components, lib, public, Button.tsx, Card.tsx, logo.svg and package.json.
search_phrases: click a folder to open it
highlight a file in a sidebar
use_when: You need to browse a shallow hierarchy of folders and files with selection and expand.
avoid_when: It is a narrow column, and very deep nesting pushes indented rows past the right edge.
customise: The tree takes an indent number and a tree instance from the headless library, while each row is an item wrapping a label; icons, names and selection styling are yours.
weight_why: A few dozen rows with colour transitions; state handling is in a small headless library.

a11y.note: Rows are real buttons with aria-expanded and arrow key hotkeys; selection is also exposed, so the main gap is the missing reduced-motion check.

issues: Selected and hovered rows share the same accent fill, so the current file cannot be told apart from a hover.
polish_why: Tidy aligned rows and clear icons, but the flat grey selection is ordinary.
title: File Tree
